items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: And on the front line they had two tromones. They had Buddy Johnson, you heard of Buddy Johnson, Mal Jis. And I believe his brother Yank... He had two trombone brothers playing trombone

ctx.x: All right then. Ernest Rapana was the bass drum player. Sometimes they would, I believe Alfred Williams played snare drum. The trumpet player had, you heard of Maurice Durand. I believe Maurice Durand was in the band at that time. Man for Rest and Maurice Durand. They had three trumpets I believe. I'm trying to think the other trumpet player. I believe, I Andrew Kimball.
